description: "Use when: writing or editing repository documentation."

# Documentation writing guidance

Write documentation for readers who want clear AI-103 study notes. Use short sentences, active voice, and plain English.

## Purpose

Each page should answer one main question. Put the most useful information first.

## Structure

Use headings, lists, tables, and diagrams to make content easy to scan. Use one `#` heading per page. Follow heading levels in order.

Recommended structure for study pages:

1. Short summary
2. When the topic matters
3. Key concepts or service purpose
4. Relationships to other Azure services
5. Certification notes
6. Official links

## Source use

Do not copy Microsoft Learn content into this repository. Write summaries in original words. Brief Azure service descriptions are allowed when they are accurate, concise, and linked to official Microsoft documentation.

## Examples

Use examples when they clarify a concept. Keep examples short unless the user asks for a full lab or code sample.

## Links

Use descriptive link text. Prefer official Microsoft documentation for Azure service facts, limits, and product behavior.
